title: Optimizing nutrition in Inflammatory Bowel Disease
summary: Chronic inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) occurs when the immune system turns against its own body. This results in an unfavorable interaction with bacteria and fungi in the intestinal lumen due to an altered mucosal barrier. The activity of this disease can be greatly reduced in a large number of patients thanks to modern therapies (including antibody therapies). In many patients, however, residual disease activity remains, which changes into residual symptoms. Our idea is that these residual symptoms can be treated with specialized nutritional therapy. Two strategies of nutritional education are compared with each other. This is not only intended to establish nutritional education in and of itself in IBD, but also to compare two therapy options methodically.

interventions.name: Face2face Medical Nutrition Therapy in IBD
30minute PowerPoint-based video on nutritional advice for IBD
